lines: Please don't hurt me.
I didn't fight you. Please let me live.
I just want to go home.
The fighting is over. Please spare me.
I don't want to die here.
Please put the weapon down.
I won't cause any trouble. Just let me go.
You already won. You don't have to kill me.
I'm scared. Please stop.
I have nowhere else to run.
Please don't make me pay for what the defenders did.
I never picked up a weapon.
Let me find somewhere safe to hide.
There has been enough fighting for one day.
I can't defend myself against you.
Please give me a chance to grow up.
I only want to get away from here.
You can leave me behind. I won't follow.
I saw what happened to everyone else. Please don't do that to me.
If there is any mercy in you, let me live.
I never raised a weapon against you. Please spare me.
The defenders are gone. You won. Let me live.
I cannot stop you. I can only ask for mercy.
Please. There has been enough <dark_red><shake>killing</shake></dark_red>.
Leave me my life, and I will remember what happened here.
I was not part of the defense.
You have nothing left to prove by killing me.
I surrender. Let that be enough.
Take what you came for and leave me breathing.
I have no armor and no weapon.
Please do not mistake helplessness for defiance.
The battle ended before you reached me.
I will not stand in your way.
You can walk away without another death.
I am asking for my life, nothing more.
There is no honor in finishing someone who surrendered.
I know the village is lost. Please let me leave it alive.
Spare me and this fight ends here.
I cannot undo the raid, but you can choose what happens now.
Please show me that victory has not emptied you of mercy.
I won't forget this.
<gold><pulse>Thank you</pulse></gold>. I thought I was going to die.
You let me live, but I still saw what happened here.
I can breathe again. Thank you.
I don't know where I'll go now.
You spared me after taking everything else.
I am grateful, even if I am still afraid of you.
I'll remember that you stopped when you could have killed me.
Please leave before you change your mind.
Thank you for putting the weapon away.
I wish none of this had happened.
You gave me another day. I will use it.
I survived, but this village will never feel the same.
I am going to find somewhere safe now.
Your mercy matters, even after all this harm.
I will tell people you chose to spare me.
The fear will take a long time to leave.
I can go home, if there is still a home to find.
Thank you. I need to get away from the fighting.
I lived because you made one better choice today.
You spared me, but you destroyed everything I knew.
I will live, and I will remember.
Mercy does not erase what happened here.
Thank you for stopping before one more death.
I did not expect to leave this village alive.
You gave me a future after taking my home.
I am grateful for my life, though not for this day.
I will carry the memory of your choice with me.
There are wounded people who may still need my help.
I need to see who else survived.
You showed mercy too late for many, but not too late for me.
I will not pretend this makes us friends.
My life is mine again. I intend to keep it.
You can leave knowing you did not kill everyone.
I hope sparing me changes what you do next.
There will be grief after you are gone.
I accept the mercy, but I cannot offer forgiveness.
I have to rebuild somewhere, if anywhere will take me.
This is the one part of the raid I can thank you for.
Go now. Let your last act here be the one that spared me.
Then do it yourself.
Please change your mind.
I don't want to die.
Don't make someone else carry out your order.
You can still tell them to stop.
Please look at me before you decide.
I never did anything to you.
There is still time to spare me.
I can't run and I can't fight back.
Please don't turn away while this happens.
If this is your choice, say it to my face.
I thought asking for mercy might matter.
You already took the village. Why take me too?
Please let me have one more day.
I don't understand why you want this.
Tell them not to hurt me.
I want to see my family again.
You can end this without ending my life.
Please don't let fear be the last thing I feel.
If you give the order, you own what happens next.
Then finish your own decision.
If that is your answer, I have nothing left to say.
You already won. This death is your choice now.
Do not hide behind someone else's weapon.
I asked for mercy and you answered with an order.
Look at what is left of the village before you continue.
There is no battle left to justify this.
If you mean to kill me, at least face me.
I cannot stop your order, but I will not call it necessary.
You could have walked away with a victory.
Remember that I surrendered before you chose this.
No one forced this decision on you.
I hope the weight of this follows you longer than the thrill of the raid.
There will be no honor in my death.
You had the power to spare me and refused.
Give the order plainly. Do not dress it up as justice.
I have made my plea. The rest belongs to you.
The village is beaten, and still you want another body.
I will meet the end knowing I never struck at you.
Do what you chose, and remember whose choice it was.
